These kinds of recurring charges should be made clear, not hidden behind confusing prompts or trial setups. I hope Apple steps in and does something about this, instead of just saying that nothing can be done. Families shouldn’t have to deal with surprise charges for a simple party game. Please check your subscriptions and be cautious before downloading.
